youtube.title: Henry VIII got engaged 1 day after beheading his wife 💍 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Henry VIII booked the best executioner in France for Anne Boleyn. Her reply is history's darkest joke 💀

Name a worse ex. We'll wait 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Anne Boleyn was executed at the Tower of London on 19 May 1536 by an expert swordsman brought over from Calais instead of an axeman. The Tower's constable William Kingston wrote that she laughed and said "I heard say the executioner was very good, and I have a little neck." Henry VIII was betrothed to Jane Seymour the next day, 20 May.
